subject: general
question: Who bagged the gold medal in the 73 kg category at the 2021 World Cadet Wrestling Championship held in Budapest, Hungary?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Priya Malik.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 2021 World Cadets Wrestling Championships **(U17) was the **World Cadets Wrestling Championship **of combined events and took place from **June 19 to 25 **in Budapest, Hungary.
 
• Last year, **Priya Malik **had become the **first Indian woman wrestler **to win gold in the **73kg weight **class (the highest) at the **U17 World. **
 
• Priya Malik won in the women’s** 73kg **weight category and she has given the country another reason to smile as, on Saturday, weightlifter **Mirabai Chanu** won a silver medal at the Tokyo Olympics.
 
• Priya Malik had also won the gold medal in the **2019** edition of Khelo India in Pune and she then went on to clinch gold at the **17th School Games held in Delhi.**
 
• Priya Malik is from Mokhra village in Haryana which has given India the likes of India's first-ever woman Olympic medallist in wrestling, **Sakshi Malik.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Babita Kumari Phogat **(born 20 November 1989)** is an Indian wrestler, who won the gold medal **in the 2014 **Commonwealth Games.
 
• Vinesh Phogat Profile Wrestling Tokyo Olympics: First woman to win Gold in Asian and Commonwealth Games and an Arjuna Awardee.
 
• Sakshi Malik became the first Indian female wrestler to win a medal at Olympics** in Rio 2016.**
 
• Sakshi Malik won the bronze medal in the **58 kg category**, becoming the first Indian female wrestler to win a medal at the Olympics.
